newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: SNB'S Meyer says has no fixed points for sfr value.
newsitem.headline: SNB'S Meyer says has no fixed points for sfr value.

text.p: Swiss National Bank (SNB) president Hans Meyer said the SNB has no set targets for the Swiss franc on foreign currency markets.
"There is no fixed point (for the franc) on one side or the other," Meyer said in response to a question after delivering a speech at an economic forum in Lucerne.
Meyer further said the SNB based its decisions regarding the currency on several pieces of economic data.
"I am careful about using the expression over- or under-valued. We are coming back from a strong currency to a normal currency," Meyer said.
He was responding to a question about whether the the Swiss currency, after its recent decline, could be considered undervalued. -- Zurich Editorial +41 1 631 7340
